t: For payment, in accordance with section 407 of the Tax Reduction and Simplification Act of 1977, to the Government of Guam, $216,000, to remain available until expended.

fable.w: This is an appropriation that funds a payment to the Government of Guam. The tempting reading is that Guam, a non-federal government, is involved, but it is only receiving money; it is not consulted on, or given a way to challenge, any federal decision. There is no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue.
fable.s: For payment, in accordance with section 407 of the Tax Reduction and Simplification Act of 1977, to the Government of Guam, $216,000, to remain available until expended.

opus.w: This provision only sets aside money for a payment to the Government of Guam. It creates no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue. A non-federal government being named as the recipient of funds does not mean it takes part in a federal decision. Getting money is closer to receiving a benefit than to participating.
opus.s: For payment, in accordance with section 407 of the Tax Reduction and Simplification Act of 1977, to the Government of Guam, $216,000, to remain available until expended.
opus.b: This section is an appropriation: it pays $216,000 to the Government of Guam under section 407 of the Tax Reduction and Simplification Act of 1977. The tempting reading is "Yes," because the Government of Guam is outside the federal government. That fails because Guam is only receiving money here. It is not consulted, not advising, and has no role in any federal decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section authorizes a specific monetary payment to the Government of Guam. It does not require consultation, coordination, or input from outside parties before a federal decision is made. It is a fiscal appropriation, not a participatory process.
qwen_chat.s: For payment, in accordance with section 407 of the Tax Reduction and Simplification Act of 1977, to the Government of Guam, $216,000, to remain available until expended.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that paying the Government of Guam involves coordination with an outside entity. However, this is a simple appropriation for payment, not a process of consultation, advisory input, or public participation in a decision-making process. The definition explicitly excludes applications for benefits or grants, and this is a direct payment authorization.
